DOCX 原生插入指令；使用空 Span []{t=\"类型\"}，类型与属性名: Native DOCX insertion command; use an empty Span []{t="type"}. Type and attribute names are case-sensitive. Other output formats remove this command
插入 Word DATE 日期域；可用于正文、页眉或页脚: Insert a Word DATE field in body text, headers or footers
日期格式，默认 yyyy-MM-dd；支持 yyyy、yy、MMMM、MMM、M: Date format, default yyyy-MM-dd; supports yyyy, yy, MMMM, MMM, MM, M, dddd, ddd, dd, d, punctuation, spaces and non-Latin text; other ASCII letters, quotes, backslashes and line breaks are unsupported
插入可在 Word 中更新的图目录；须单独占据一个段落: Insert an updatable Word list of figures; must occupy its own paragraph
图目录标题，默认 List of Figures；空字符串隐藏标题: List of figures title, default List of Figures; an empty string hides the title
插入可在 Word 中更新的表目录；须单独占据一个段落: Insert an updatable Word list of tables; must occupy its own paragraph
表目录标题，默认 List of Tables；空字符串隐藏标题: List of tables title, default List of Tables; an empty string hides the title
插入分页符，可嵌入段落；没有额外属性: Insert a page break, including within a paragraph; no additional attributes
插入 Word PAGE 页码域；可用于正文、页眉或页脚，支持外层 Markdo: Insert a Word PAGE field in body text, headers or footers; surrounding Markdown font formatting is supported
页码格式，默认跟随当前节；decimal 为阿拉伯数字，upper/lowerR: Page number format, inherited from the current section by default; decimal, upper/lowerRoman and upper/lowerLetter are supported, as are their Word field format names
插入分节符并配置后续节；须单独位于正文顶层段落，不能放在表格、列表、引用或脚注中: Insert a section break and configure the following section; must occupy a top-level body paragraph outside tables, lists, quotations and footnotes
后续节的独立页脚 Markdown；空字符串清空页脚，可包含 []{t=\"pa: Independent footer Markdown for the following section; an empty string clears it; may include []{t="pageNum"} or date fields
独立页脚的水平对齐，默认 center；必须同时提供 footer: Horizontal alignment of the independent footer, default center; requires footer
是否链接前一节页脚；无 footer 时默认 true，有 footer 时默认: Link to the previous section footer; default true without footer, false with footer; true conflicts with footer
后续节的独立页眉 Markdown；空字符串清空页眉，可包含 []{t=\"pa: Independent header Markdown for the following section; an empty string clears it; may include []{t="pageNum"} or date fields
独立页眉的水平对齐，默认 center；必须同时提供 header: Horizontal alignment of the independent header, default center; requires header
是否链接前一节页眉；无 header 时默认 true，有 header 时默认: Link to the previous section header; default true without header, false with header; true conflicts with header
分节方式，默认 nextPage；continuous 连续，oddPage 奇: Section break type, default nextPage; continuous, oddPage and evenPage are also supported
后续节页码起始值，整数 0 到 2147483647；省略时延续页码: Starting page number for the following section, an integer from 0 to 2147483647; omitted to continue numbering
插入可在 Word 中更新的目录；须单独占据一个段落: Insert an updatable Word table of contents; must occupy its own paragraph
收录的标题级数，1 到 9，默认 3: Heading levels to include, from 1 to 9; default 3
目录标题，默认 Contents；空字符串隐藏标题: Table of contents title, default Contents; an empty string hides the title
表格题注末尾的属性；例如 : Results {#tbl:results cel: Attributes at the end of a table caption; for example : Results {#tbl:results cell_margin="0.1cm"}
DOCX 表格在页面中的水平对齐: Horizontal alignment of a DOCX table on the page
DOCX 表格列宽模式：fixed 固定列宽，content 按内容调整，win: DOCX table column width mode: fixed, content or window
英文副题注；与中文题注组成双语题注: English secondary caption, paired with a Chinese caption for bilingual captions
所有单元格的内边距；各方向的单独设置可覆盖它，支持 cm、mm、in、pt: Padding for all cells, overridden by individual sides; supports cm, mm, in and pt
单元格下内边距，覆盖 cell_margin 的下侧: Bottom cell padding, overriding the bottom side of cell_margin
单元格左内边距，覆盖 cell_margin 的左侧: Left cell padding, overriding the left side of cell_margin
单元格右内边距，覆盖 cell_margin 的右侧: Right cell padding, overriding the right side of cell_margin
单元格上内边距，覆盖 cell_margin 的上侧: Top cell padding, overriding the top side of cell_margin
历史保留的单元格间距属性；当前仅传递该值，不会据此调整 DOCX / HTML: Legacy cell spacing attribute; currently passed through without changing DOCX or HTML cell spacing
应用 reference.docx 中的 Word 表格样式；样式名须与参考文档: Apply a Word table style from reference.docx by exact name; HTML uses the supported table appearance properties
应用到所有表格单元格段落的 Word 文本样式: Word text style applied to paragraphs in all table cells
标红指定列；从 1 开始计数，用逗号分隔；* 表示全部列并标红题注: Mark specified columns in red, using comma-separated one-based indices; * marks all columns and the caption
标红指定行；从 1 开始计数并包含表头，用逗号分隔；* 表示全部行并标红题注: Mark specified rows in red, including the header, using comma-separated one-based indices; * marks all rows and the caption
DOCX 表格行高，支持 cm、mm、in、pt: DOCX table row height; supports cm, mm, in and pt
双栏 LaTeX 文档中让表格跨两栏: Span a table across both columns in a two-column LaTeX document
是否将 DOCX 公式转换为可编辑 MathType 公式: Convert DOCX equations to editable MathType equations
Typst 数学字体名称或字体文件路径: Typst math font name or font file path
普通数学符号字体，与 calligraphicFont 一起填写；也可输入字体文: Regular math symbol font, specified together with calligraphicFont; a font file path is also accepted
花体数学符号字体，与 font 一起填写；也可输入字体文件路径: Calligraphic math symbol font, specified together with font; a font file path is also accepted
是否使用 Word 原生 REF/SEQ 域和章节编号: Use native Word REF/SEQ fields and section numbering
手写表格默认布局: Default layout for manually authored tables
是否内嵌 SVG 引用的本地子图像: Embed local subimages referenced by SVG files
是否将 DOCX 中的 SVG 栅格化为 PNG: Rasterize SVG images in DOCX as PNG
数字引文范围分隔符，例如 - 生成 [1-3]: Numeric citation range delimiter; for example - produces [1-3]
是否显示 DOCX 页脚页码: Show page numbers in the DOCX footer
DOCX 页脚；null 保留参考文档页脚，空 content 清空页脚: DOCX footer; null preserves the reference document footer, empty content clears it
页脚 Markdown 内容；例如 []{t=\"pageNum\"} 插入页码: Footer Markdown content; for example []{t="pageNum"} inserts a page number
DOCX 页眉；null 保留参考文档页眉，空 content 清空页眉: DOCX header; null preserves the reference document header, empty content clears it
页眉 Markdown 内容；例如 []{t=\"pageNum\" forma: Header Markdown content; for example []{t="pageNum" format="upperRoman"} inserts a page number
DOCX 页面宽度，例如 21cm；null 保留参考文档宽度: DOCX page width; for example 21cm; null preserves the reference document width
按精确 DOCX 样式名称设置段落或字符样式: Configure paragraph or character styles by exact DOCX style name
字体名称，或分别指定西文和中文字体: Font name, or separate Western and Chinese fonts
西文字体名称，例如 Times New Roman: Western font name; for example Times New Roman
中文字体名称，例如 宋体: Chinese font name; for example SimSun
字体大小，例如 10.5pt、小五或四号；也可输入其他正磅值: Font size; for example 10.5pt or a Chinese named size; other positive point sizes are accepted
字体颜色，例如 #000000、rgb(0, 0, 0) 或 [0, 0, 0]: Font color; for example #000000, rgb(0, 0, 0) or [0, 0, 0]; hexadecimal colors must be quoted
行距倍数、single、one-half、double 或精确磅值: Line spacing multiplier, single, one-half, double or an exact point size
Word 字符数形式的首行缩进: First line indentation in Word character units
段前间距，例如 6pt: Space before a paragraph; for example 6pt
段后间距，例如 6pt: Space after a paragraph; for example 6pt
是否自动为章节添加 sec: 标签: Automatically add sec: labels to sections
文档语言，例如 zh-CN 或 en-US: Document language; for example zh-CN or en-US
子图题注模板，$$i$$ 为编号，$$t$$ 为文字: Subfigure caption template; $$i$$ is the number and $$t$$ is the text
父图题注模板，$$i$$ 为编号，$$t$$ 为文字: Parent figure caption template; $$i$$ is the number and $$t$$ is the text
编号和题注之间的分隔符: Delimiter between a number and its caption
传给 Pandoc、pandoc-crossref 和 citeproc 的元数: Metadata passed to Pandoc, pandoc-crossref and citeproc; other valid metadata is allowed
审稿回复构建的覆盖配置；null 清除继承的回复配置: Build overrides for reviewer replies; null clears inherited reply settings
本稿件的格式与构建覆盖配置，高于 style.yml；相对字体文件路径以当前 M: Formatting and build overrides for this manuscript, taking precedence over style.yml; relative font paths resolve from the Markdown directory
稿件摘要，可使用 | 编写多行文本: Manuscript abstract; use | for multiline text
共享机构映射，affiliations 的兼容别名: Shared affiliation mapping; compatibility alias for affiliations
共享机构名称，可在作者 affiliation 或 affiliations 中: Shared affiliation name, referenced by its identifier in author affiliation or affiliations
共享机构映射，由作者的 affiliation 或 affiliations 通: Shared affiliation mapping, referenced by identifiers in author affiliation or affiliations
作者列表，authors 的兼容别名: Author list; compatibility alias for authors
作者所属机构名称或共享机构标识，可填写一个或多个: Author affiliation names or shared identifiers; accepts one or more
作者所属机构名称或共享机构标识列表: List of author affiliation names or shared identifiers
设为 true 生成默认通讯作者脚注，也可填写自定义脚注文本: Use true for the default corresponding author footnote, or supply custom footnote text
作者邮箱，用于生成通讯作者脚注: Author email, used in the corresponding author footnote
作者姓名，每位作者必须填写: Author name, required for every author
作者职称，显示在通讯作者脚注中: Author title, shown in the corresponding author footnote
作者列表，每位作者使用包含 name 的对象，可填写机构、邮箱和通讯作者信息: Author list; each author is an object with name and optional affiliations, email and corresponding author details
参考文献数据库路径，例如 references.bib；支持多个文件路径: Bibliography database path; for example references.bib; multiple paths are supported
LaTeX 文档类选项列表，例如 [preprint, 3p, authorye: LaTeX document class options; for example [preprint, 3p, authoryear]
LaTeX 文档类，例如 elsarticle、svjour3、WileyNJD: LaTeX document class; for example elsarticle, svjour3, WileyNJDv5 or IEEEtran
追加到输出文档头部的内容，例如 LaTeX 包或期刊信息: Content appended to the output document header; for example LaTeX packages or journal information
额外列入参考文献的条目；填写 '@*' 可列入所有未引用条目: Additional bibliography entries; '@*' includes all uncited entries
审稿回复对应的稿件 Markdown 路径，例如 manuscript.md；用: Manuscript Markdown path for reviewer replies; for example manuscript.md; used for line numbers and cross references
